scenario.service: local app connected to VoteFeed Dev

comparison.result: Same content and line wrapping in all three browsers. Firefox differed from Chromium by at most 0.61px in the measured text widths; no material layout or wrapping change was visible.
comparison.console: Chrome and Edge reported the configured Clerk development-key warning. Firefox reported that an external Clerk development-domain _cfuvid cookie had an invalid domain; the guest Elections view and local Inter font still loaded. No local application runtime error was observed.
limits: The comparison covers a second rendering engine on Windows; it does not compare a second operating system.
The guest live sample uses MA-8 and Massachusetts Senate content; it does not establish signed-in behavior.
